thread:
Ravi: Heads up: noticed p99 anomaly on the latency dashboard for /v1/embed after we pushed the new routing weight adjustment. p50/p95 stable but p99 is spiking ~220ms.
Tess: Was there any sampling config change?
Ravi: Yes  fallback pool applies 1/20 sampling and it got ~30% of the route when weights shifted.
Aj: That will do it. If our tdigest rollup merged a small sampled digest with a large raw digest we can get weird tails.
Samir: Can we capture a simple provenance string in the UI? like "p99 derived from ingress-sampled t-digest (n=1,120)" so it's obvious.
Tess: Proposal: small inline badge next to percentiles: "n=1.1k" and tooltip: "origin: ingress-sampled; merged_count: 180; raw_count: 1120; routing_snapshot: rw-2026-03-22-21"
Ravi: Also want a backend guard: if p99 shift > 100ms while merged_count < 200 then mark the percentile as low-confidence and don't auto-escalate.
Aj: We'll need rollup proto updates. Add merged_count (required) and raw_count (optional) + origin enum. Aggregator to preserve both when possible.
Tess: UI devs: small badge + circled-exclamation for low-confidence.
console-bot: ticket created: "percentile-provenance-badges" -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/4268. Assigned Aj.
Samir: I'll add a query to find endpoints where fallback correlates with sample_count drop-off and paste into the ticket.
Ravi: Great, thanks. This will save oncall time and make rollouts less noisy.
